OTTER QUOTES / Contractors Compete. Homeowners Win.
**Get Multiple Bids Easily:** We help you create a scope of work and then we send it to multiple contractors. So you get multiple bids from contractors quickly and easily.
**Eliminate Unnecessary Expenses:** Nearly 40% of your contractor's expenses have nothing to do with your job. Marketing expenses, sales commissions, truck payments and overhead add nothing to the value of your home. But your contractor has to bake these into the cost of your new home. Otter Quotes eliminates these expenses. All our contractors have to do is open their laptop and submit their bids. They know they are competing with other contractors with these same advantages - so those savings get passed along to you.
**Compare Bids from Subcontractors:** Get bids from the contractor brands you know, and the subcontractors who actually do the work. Find out how much you can save by dealing with them directly!
**Better Materials and Warranties:** When a contractor is the only one sitting at the kitchen table with you, the better materials and warranties are upgrades. When they are competing for your business, they get thrown in for free to win your business.
**Easier Decisions:** We put all the information you need in one place. Reviews, licenses, and insurance all on the site. Right next to their bids. So you can make decisions based on what matters.
**Easier Process:** With Otter Quotes, you don't sit through a single sales call. It takes about 15 minutes to create your account and tell us what you need. Then you can review your quotes online, pick a contractor, and get started. No pants required!
